posts.name: Adam
posts.cooked:
Hey, everybody! I just launched a new twitter account, on which I'll be posting a bunch of cool stuff! Stuff like art previews, process images, character sketches, older artwork, etc. So if that's something that sounds really neato to you, give it a follow -- @GTGAdam. Also, if there's anything specific you'd like to see, speak up! Let me know! You don't ask, you don't get! What do you have to lose, really? I'll pop this link down here, too:

Link.

posts.cooked:
Any old iterations of current characters that have really changed from inception to final form? Those would be cool to see.

The multi-proccess picture you have on the twitter page for Captain Cosmic and that other guy is awesome. I'd be really keen on seeing the full pictures of each of those steps for any past/present/future art you might have.

Also, that new promo secret promo from the preorder event would be awesome to see!

Anyway, glad you are doing this Adam. I'm really looking forward to seeing more of your awesome work!
